acceptance_criteria: All instructions are summarized; locked files and forbidden commands recorded.

task: Record checkout SHA, branch, status and version
acceptance_criteria: Exact baseline file includes SHA, dirty files, Flutter/Dart, package and CI/release evidence.
Before/after status diff shows no unrelated changes removed or overwritten.
Flutter/Dart/Gradle/Android/iOS and dependency list captured from actual checkout.

task: Run required Graphify query before source exploration
acceptance_criteria: Query/output recorded or explicit blocker documented.

task: Build risk register for payment/security paths
acceptance_criteria: All high-risk findings have severity, evidence, owner and containment.
Generated candidates include route/navigation/symbol/API outputs and scan report.
Every route declaration has source line, target widget and catalog entry.
GetX, Navigator, go_router or current mechanisms reconciled to route catalog.

task: Discover dialogs, sheets, nested pages and tabs
acceptance_criteria: All overlay/nested entries are categorized; no assumption that routes file is exhaustive.
Every active screen has owner or documented unresolved status.
Dependencies from controller to data layer are evidence-linked.
Each backend-backed operation has endpoint/contract or blocker.
Protected and conditionally visible paths are recorded.

task: Catalog localization keys and supported locales
acceptance_criteria: Actual ARB/key coverage reconciled against pubspec and generated localizations.
Existing test coverage and asset/animation usage mapped.
Every critical route has actual environment evidence or explicit BLOCKED.

task: Reconcile orphan, duplicate and obsolete screens
acceptance_criteria: Potentially unreachable/duplicate symbols are triaged, not automatically deleted.
Balance/status/fee/rate/KYC/card/address owners are explicit.
All known API error categories have stable mapping and localized action.
Pending/failed/success/unknown/reconciling have clear semantics and transition rules.
Every mutating flow documents duplicate-submit and unknown-outcome handling.

task: Define money amount and precision rules
acceptance_criteria: Currency metadata and decimal/minor unit representation are explicit and tested.
Quote ID, expiry, fee breakdown, total debit and recipient gets documented.
All cross-module consumers know when and how to refetch or mark stale.

task: Define deep-link security and session flow
acceptance_criteria: Protected route behavior after expired session and notification entry is specified.

task: Create dependency ADR template and first ADRs
acceptance_criteria: All material architecture/package changes have alternatives and compatibility notes.

task: Unify API request/error handling under current architecture
acceptance_criteria: Request lifecycle, errors, correlation ID and timeouts consistent without blanket rewrite.
Expired/invalid session handling tested during reads and mutations.
Shared patterns are documented and consumed by scoped screen samples.

task: Audit all existing design system components
acceptance_criteria: API, owners, usages, broken callbacks and state semantics documented.

task: Fix or flag no-op CTA and default-success hazards
acceptance_criteria: Every visible CTA has valid action/disabled reason; receipt status explicit.

task: Standardize form field validation and focus
acceptance_criteria: Error is inline/actionable and accessible in the critical forms.
Formatting, parsing and precision tests pass for actual currencies/locales.
One mapping of canonical statuses is used in history, receipt, notifications.
Page refresh/pagination errors do not duplicate/drop rows.
Critical journeys preserve expected tab/back behavior and cannot bypass guards.
Every step and API/validation/status/error documented.
Source, recipient, currency, amount, fees, total debit and receive value visible.
Repeated taps/navigation retries cannot create a second logical transfer.
Unknown result triggers safe status lookup, not blind resubmission.

task: Document and harden exchange quote lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Expired quotes refresh and require renewed confirmation.

task: Verify exchange precision and rate mapping
acceptance_criteria: Source/target amounts and rounding match authoritative response.
Destination, limits, fee, pending payout, failure and status check work.
Price/fee freshness, submit, failure and receipt states documented/tested.
Source/destination/network and QR amount rules validated.

task: Verify receipt status and details against backend
acceptance_criteria: No default-success or local status synthesis; export/share redacts sensitive data.
Available/pending balance and freshness are consistent across modules.
Post-operation screens converge on authoritative balances and statuses.
KYC/provider restrictions and pending issuance are correctly represented.
UI follows confirmed issuer status and handles unknown response safely.
Unsupported or mismatched network fails closed.
No fabricated/fallback address; metadata and QR come from valid source.
All required network/provider parameters are explicit and tested.

task: Audit confirmation and pending crypto transactions
acceptance_criteria: Confirmation counts/state do not prematurely become success.
Changes appear consistently in history, receipts and notifications.
Resend cooldown, invalid/expired code, lockout and session error tested.
Missing, wrong, locked and not-configured states are distinct.

task: Audit KYC upload and status lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Submitted/review/rejected/action-required states and safe retry implemented.
Saved values map to authoritative data and survive appropriate app restart.
Timeout/double submit does not create duplicate tickets.
Deduplication, unread state, auth guard and destination freshness verified.
Filters, permissions, file retention and PII redaction verified.
Pending operations/status and session refreshed after resume.

task: Create pilot specs and before screenshots
acceptance_criteria: Home, Wallet Details, Transfer Review, Receipt have device/locale/theme metadata.

task: Upgrade Home/dashboard from real data states
acceptance_criteria: Quick actions are valid; balances/activity loading/error/stale are coherent.
Consistent hierarchy, money display, empty/error and refresh patterns.
Each discovered route has spec, state coverage, visual proof and tests.

task: Upgrade all card and crypto pages
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility, network, status, errors and sensitive actions have safe confirmation.
Accessible forms, clear error/recovery copy and security states.
Canonical transaction status and navigation behavior shared.
No route omitted; deferred items have explicit exception.
Every discovered overlay has responsive, keyboard, dismiss and error rules.

task: Run visual consistency review over the full inventory
acceptance_criteria: No isolated pilot design; all pages consume approved tokens/components or documented exception.
Behavior/state—not just widget existence—is covered.
Precision, fee, quote expiry, status mapping and idempotency policies have tests.

task: Create integration tests per critical flow
acceptance_criteria: Successful, validation, timeout, pending and retry paths tested in sandbox.

task: Create visual/golden baseline for critical screens
acceptance_criteria: Stable environment, approved diff, all material variants recorded.
Unknown/unmapped routes make coverage gate fail visibly.
No missing keys or argument mismatch across actual supported locales.
fa/ar and long/Russian/CJK strings reviewed on critical pages.

task: Audit text scaling, contrast and semantics
acceptance_criteria: Critical screens pass accessibility checks and manual assistive review.
Critical surfaces and transaction statuses remain clear in both themes.

task: Ensure final test sequence is serial and reproducible
acceptance_criteria: Integrator records commands, SHA and exit codes; parallel agents do not run prohibited tests.

task: Audit sensitive data in logs and events
acceptance_criteria: No credential, passcode, secret, full card/account or unapproved raw payload.
Every accepted new dependency has evidence and ADR; no mass installation.
Baseline and changed results recorded on specified device/build.
No major jank/memory regression; fix tied to measured hotspot.
Allowlisted events and retention/purpose policy approved.
No request storms, stale response overwrite, or harmful mutations on retries.

task: Reconcile source, route catalog and runtime routes
acceptance_criteria: All discovered candidates are categorized; unresolveds visible.
Present/not present/out-of-scope/blocked status supported by evidence.

task: Triage and close all P0 findings
acceptance_criteria: No P0 open on money integrity, auth/session, security or critical route.
Any accepted exception has owner, rationale, risk and date.
Exact SHA, commands, statuses, screenshots, tests, unresolved items linked.

task: Run serial release-like smoke with sandbox services
acceptance_criteria: Critical flows pass on build/artifact; no production financial operations.

task: Verify no unintended Git or remote actions
acceptance_criteria: Working tree diff is explainable; no push/tag/release/deploy performed.

task: Request explicit owner approval for release separately
acceptance_criteria: Package itself never performs or authorizes release/deploy.
